route_title: Decoupled mid-stack perturbation with frozen edge layers for dual-band HfO2/SiO2 optimization
compilation_rationale: Bounded 24-layer dielectric stack on fused silica with explicit alternating HfO2/SiO2 sequence. Optimization applies absolute perturbation bounds to 16 inner layers while freezing 4 outer pairs on each side. Spectral objectives directly score maximized transmission in 1000–1700 nm and maximized reflection in 300–450 nm using coherent TMM.
